timeline.title: Reyna and Sage, Ascent
timeline.caption: A Valorant match. I was on Reyna, you were locking Sage. Neither of us knew that round was about to turn into a whole relationship.

timeline.title: day one
timeline.caption: We said yes to each other for the first time.

timeline.title: the plot twist
timeline.caption: You left for a week to go figure something out with an ex. It blew up spectacularly. We laugh about it now, but at the time neither of us saw that coming.

timeline.title: the real start
timeline.caption: You made me a whole PDF. Custom fonts, backgrounds, screenshots, a video of you talking, voice notes, your own photos. An actual presentation. I don't think I stood a chance after that. This is the day we actually began.

timeline.title: chocolates on Blinkit
timeline.caption: You were on your period and I sent chocolates over on a whim. Small thing, but it's the kind of small thing that matters.

timeline.title: introduced to your mum
timeline.caption: You introduced me to your mum. That's not a small thing either.
